name: czrecoil_frame_start_campaign_mode_3
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuStartCampaignMode3 dispatches campaign mode id 4 through RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4312d0 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
